type mapping

// require raylib                  every function, struct and enum below
// require raylib/raylib_boost     also the color constants and the enum overloads

Vector2, Vector3, Vector4   -> float2, float3, float4
Quaternion                  -> float4
Rectangle                   -> float4       // x, y, width, height
Color (by value)            -> float4       // RGBA in 0..1, converted to bytes for you
Matrix (by value)           -> float4x4     // converted for you
Color, Matrix (in pointers and struct fields) stay raw: use the converters
const char *                -> string
T *                         -> T?

// float4 is both Color and Rectangle: the parameter name tells you which.
// Enum parameters are plain int unless a raylib_boost overload is listed.
